opening.argument: The item shown is a physical movie gift card advertising six free films. The speaker identifies the card, says its reverse lists the movies and a website, and suggests leaving cards on a desk so interested people can take one. That is ordinary promotion and distribution of a card directing people to religious-themed films. Nothing in the cited presentation offers an investment, prize, or paid financial opportunity, or asks viewers to provide private data. The record supports the limited conclusion that the card is being used to share access to free films, not a claim about what any recipient ultimately does with it.
